evals.name: current-info-answer-first
evals.prompt: whats the latest node LTS and when does it stop getting security updates
evals.expected_output: Answer-first reply naming the current LTS version and its end-of-support date, with inline markdown link citations to an authoritative source. Short and mobile-skimmable. No trailing Sources section, no file written.

evals.name: double-check-falsification
evals.prompt: my friend told me the airpods pro 2 work fully with android phones, all the features. is that actually right? double check before you answer
evals.expected_output: Runs a falsification pass: restates as a universal, searches for the negation (features that do NOT work on Android), reports counterexamples (spatial audio, adaptive features, firmware updates etc. are limited without iOS) with inline citations. Does not just confirm. Names where it looked.

evals.name: shopping-recommendation
evals.prompt: recommend me a good budget mechanical keyboard under $100, i mostly type for work not gaming
evals.expected_output: A concrete product recommendation with a direct inline link to the product page, an image when available, and reasoning tied to typing (not gaming). Mobile-skimmable. Inline links, no footnote list.
